content: Jesu Morobone Misir Maiye
Sunday maraumanika baibin raiy hibogaigiwas hi’inu’in hibow hin rah yan hitit.
Naatu hin rah yan hitit ana veya kabay gagamin Jesu ana hub awan hiya’afut inu’in hifururuw tit hub awan asir inu’in hi’itin.
Basit wanawanan hirun hin, baise Regah Jesu biyan men hitita’urimih.
Nati’imaim hai kasiy ra’at hibat hibinubunibun naniyan meyemeye orot rou’ab hai bonamanamarin auman sisibihimaim himatar hibat.
Baibin hai bir ra’at nahimaim yumatah au babe me yan hire, baise orot rou’ab hi’uwih hio, “Kwa aisim orot yawasin isan sabuw murubin hai efanamaim kwanunuwih?
Iti’imaim boro men kwana’itin, i morobone misir maiye! Galilee imaim bairi kwama’am ana veya tur abisa eo i kwanotanot.
‘Orot Natun i boro hinab sabuw kakafih umahimaim hinayai, hina’onaf, naatu veya tounu ufunamaim morobone nayawas maiye.’”
Imaibo baibin ana tur eo nuhih taseb hinot.
Naatu rahane himatabir maiye hina bar hitit. Sawar abisa’awat hi’i’itah ana bai’ufununayah nah 11 naatu bai’ufununayah afa nati baremaim hima’am auman hai tur hi’owen.
Baibin iyabowat sawar hi’itah hina Jesu ana tur abarayah hai tur hio’owen wabih i Mary Magdalin, Joanna naatu Mary, James hinah naatu baibin afa auman.
Baise Jesu ana tur abarayah baibin hio men hitumatum, anayabin hai tur hinonowar naniyan i tamim tao kwanekwan na’atube.
Baise Peter misir nunuw in rah yan tit, hub wanawanan kwaf nuwariy faifuwawat hi’inu’in itah, basit abisa mamatar isan erebainotanot auman matabir in.
Emmaus Ef Yanamaim
Nati veya ta’imon Jesu ana bai’ufununayah orot rou’ab Jerusalemane hin bar merar ta wabin Emmaus imaim hitit. Jerusalem in Emmaus titit ana fofonin i 11 kilometres na’atube.
Baise iti orot rou’ab efamaim sawar abisa’awat himamatar isah hairi hio hidudur hinan ana veya,
Jesu ufuhine natit botanih bairi hita’imon hiremor hin.
Naatu bairi hinan i hi’itin baise men kafa’imo hi’inan.
Jesu ibatiyih, “Kwa abisa isan tura airi kwaidudur auman kwanan?” Naatu orot rou’ab hinutanub yah rererey yen hibat.
Orot ta wabin Cleopas ibatiy eo, “Jerusalem wanawanan o akisimo nanawan orot, imih sawar abisa fai fur wanawanan mamatar o men iso’obamih?”

Jesu ibatiyih, “Sawar abistan?” Hiya’afut hio, “God ana dinab orot wabin Jesu Nazareth matuwan, God matanamaim na’atube sabuw matahimaim ana tur eo naatu ana bowabow sisinaf etei i fairih naatu turobe.
Baise aki ai firis ukwarih naatu bonawiyenayah orot ukwarih hibai Roman gawan hitin, morobomih eo ibasit naatu hibai hin hi’onaf morob.
Aki anotanot iti orot boro Israel sabuw baiyawasih arouw nuhifot ama’am, baise iti orot hirab momorob i veya boun tounu sawar.
Naatu baibin afa aki ai kou’ayomaim boun maraumanika hin rah yan hititit biyan hiboyouw
naatu himatabir hina hio, ‘Aki tounamatar ai’itih, naatu tounamatar ai tur hi’owen Jesu i morobone misir maiye.’ Iti na’at hio aki aoror sa’iri ai kasiy ra’at.
Basit ai kou’ayomaim sabuw afa hin rah yan hit abisa baibin hio hinowar na’atube hi’itah, baise Jesu men hi’itinimih.”
Imaibo Jesu iuwih eo, “Kwa i kwabikoko’aw, aisim dinab oro’orot abisa hio hikikirum men fudir rerekab kwabitumatumamih!
Keriso iti sawar etei isah ni’akir biyan nababan saise ana aiwob maramaim narun nabi’aiwob isan men kwaso’ob?”
Imaibo Jesu taiyuwin isan aneika Moses ana Buk kikirum imaim busuruf idudur rena God ana dinab oro’orot hai Buk hikikirum imaim tit.
Naatu bar merar hinuh hinanamaim hititit auman, Jesu bar merar ta namihibe iwa’an hi’itin.
Baise hi’otan hio, “Veya sawar naatu mar efof imih tarun bairit ta’in.” Iti na’at hio itin, basit bairi inumih hirun.
Bay aa isan Jesu bairi himare, eof rafiy bai God ana merar yi sawar imasib itih.
Imaibo hairi matah to iwa’an hi’inan, baise marta’imon na’am sa’iwa’an.
Hairi himisir hio, “Efamaim tanan Buk Atamaninamaim bidudur dogorot ahayabe yiy naniyan itatam?”
Basit himisir himatabir maiye hin Jerusalem hitit, nati’imaim bai’ufununayah nah 11 naatu afa auman hiru’ay hima’am hi’itih,
hai tur hi’owen hio, “Tur anababatun Regah i morobone misir maiye Simon isan irerereb.
Orot rou’ab efamaim abisa mamatar naatu mi’itube rafiy imasib bitih ana veya’amaim matah to iwa’an hi’i’inan etei hidudur turahinah hinowar.
Jesu Ana Bai’ufununayah Isah Irerereb
Orot rou’ab iti na’atube hima hio hinonowar auman naniyan meyemeye Regah nah yan foun matar bat iuwih eo, “Tufuw isa nama.”
Etei hi’oror, hai bir ra’at, hinotanot i yoyom mowan itinin hirouw.
Baise Jesu iuwih eo, “Aisim kwabirubir naatu aisim a not boro’ika tekakasiy?
Au umau kwa’itah, naatu biyau kwabutubun finimu au rakit naniyan kwatatam, saise kwanaso’ob iti i anababatun ayu, anayabin yoyom i aurih finimih en.”
Iti ra’at eo sawar basit an uman i’obaiyih hi’itan.
Baise men kafa’imo hitumatumamih, hai kawasa ra’at hikasiy auman, basit Jesu ibatiyih, “Kwa bay urey ta kwayai inu’in?”
Siy baibitab finimin reban hibai hitin
naatu nahimaim bat eaan hi’itin.

Imaibo hai tur eowen eo, “Ayu i sawar iti isah bairit tama’ama ana veya a tur aowen. Sawar abisa ayu isau mataramih Moses ana Bukamaim, dinab hai Bukamaim na’atube Psalms imaim hio hikikirum hina hiturobe.”
Imaibo hai not botawiy Buk Atamaninamaim abisa isan hio hikikirum naniyan hibai.
Naatu iuwih eo, “Abisa hio hikikirum anayabin i iti, Keriso i ni’akir biyan nababan namorob, naatu veya tounu ufunamaim boro nayawas maiye namisir.
Saise i wabinamaim ya baikitabir naatu notawiyen ana tur Jerusalemamaim an hinayai hinabinan hinatit hinan tafaram tutufin etei hinanowar.
Imih kwa abisa matamaim kwa’i’itin i kwanakubuna sabuw etei hai tur kwana’owen hinanowar.
Jerusalemamaim kwanama ayu Tamai abisa baitimih eo’omatani marane aniyafar nare a fair kwanab.”
Jesu Au Mar Yen
Imaibo nawiyih bairi Jerusalem hihamiy hitit hin Bethany hitit, nati’imaim uman bora’ah isah yoyoban igegewasinih.
Bigegewasinih auman ihamiyih earura’ah yen in mar wanawanan run.
Hibora’ara’ah yasisir yah awan karatan auman himatabir maiye hin Jerusalem hitit.
Nati’imaim mar etei hin Tafaror Baremaim God ana merar hiyiy naatu hibobora’ara’ah.
